-  \ it.\n\nWHY THE OLD `done` WAS FALSE, verified three ways this round. (a) The advertised\
-  \ deliverable `instHasPicScheme` exists in NO `.lean` file — 16 grep hits project-wide,\
-  \ every one a docstring or comment mention; it was deleted 2026-07-28 under decision\

-  \ which needs the Quot scheme)\" and the Altman-Kleiman quotient lemma, and that\

-  \ not `smoothProperQuotient`: it is G2, the FINITE GALOIS quotient of a semilinear\
-  \ action whose finite orbits lie in affine opens, which is landed (`Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient.lean`,\

-  \ the sorry; the docstring's prescription of the inputs is simply wrong, and it\
-  \ has been costing every reader who trusted it. Issue filed; the docstring is corrected\
-  \ in place.\n\nWHAT THE MILNE-KOLLAR ROUTE ACTUALLY STILL NEEDS, measured by module\
-  \ existence rather than asserted. LANDED: B0 `Picard/SectionRingUniversal.lean`,\
-  \ B2 `Picard/FinitePresentationFunctor.lean`, B3 `Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`\
-  \ + the discharged gate `AJC.picrep.rigidpushforward`, D1'/A2 `Picard/DivDegree.lean`,\
-  \ G2 `Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient.lean` + `GaloisDescent/`, P2 `RiemannRoch/CohomologyKit.lean`,\
-  \ and the whole Grassmannian/flattening/graded substrate (`AJC.grquot`, sorry-free,\
-  \ with `Grassmannian.representable` proved). ABSENT AS MODULES, i.e. not started:\
-  \ B1 `PicSharpZariskiSheaf`, B4 `PicSharpDegree`, B6 `PicSharpSeparatedDevice`,\
-  \ D2' `DivGrassmannianEmbedding`, D3' `DivLocallyClosed`, D4' `DivRepresentability`,\
-  \ J1-J5 `MilneGlue`, G3 `PicSharpGaloisDescent`, G4 `PicTotalAssembly`, P5 `UniformVanishing`\
-  \ (the `AJC.rr.extuniform` leaf, open). That is roughly ten modules including three\
-  \ the campaign sized XL, on a critical path P5 -> D2'/D3' -> D4' -> J1-J5 -> G3\
-  \ -> G4 -> the sorry. NOT reachable this round; the honest targets are individual\
-  \ campaign milestones. Claimed this round: D2' by ajc-p1 (AJC.picrep.divgrassmannian),\
-  \ D3' by ajc-p3 (AJC.picrep.divlocallyclosed), B5 by ajc-p4 (AJC.picrep.semicontinuity),\
-  \ P5 by ajc-p2 (AJC.rr.extuniform).\n\nTHE ELEVENTH ITEM IS WITHDRAWN -- IT WAS\
-  \ REFUTED IN-TREE, AND BY THE TIME I RE-READ IT THE REFUTATION HAD BEEN SITTING\
-  \ IN THE PROJECT FOR HOURS (review-ajc, third pass, 2026-07-29; kernel-verified).\n\
-  \nWHAT TWO EARLIER PASSES OF THIS SAME LANE PUBLISHED HERE, as the round's headline\
-  \ finding: \"every campaign milestone targets picSharp while clause (1) is about\
-  \ picEt; the gap CANNOT be closed by composing with picEtComparison, which is an\
-  \ iso only under a section -- so completing all ten modules leaves the sorry open.\"\

-  \ REFUTATION, in this project, axiom-clean. `Scheme.picSharp_representableBy_picEt_transport`\

-  \ so this is not read as the seam being close. Both antecedents above are the campaign's\

-  \ (`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean:312`, the legacy `picSharp` shape) has ZERO\
-  \ instances: its only producer `picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint` (`:645`) is deliberately\
-  \ not an instance and needs `[HasRationalPoint C]`, which has no unconditional producer\

-  \ at `:489`. New work goes against `HasPicSchemeEt`/`picEt`.\n\nTHE DEAD-CONSUMER\

-  \ it. 70 DECLARATIONS bind `[HasPicScheme]` and 27 bind `[HasPicSchemeEt]`. Method,\

-  \ 5, HomogeneityOrbitCollapse 2 -- and the 27 in three: Pic0EtTangentSpace 12, Pic0Et\
-  \ 10, FGAPicRepresentability 5.\n\nWHAT THE 70 MEAN -- AND THE ANSWER IS NOW A THEOREM\

-  \ unreachable: `HasPicScheme` has no instance, and even granting one, clause (1)\
-  \ of the seam is about `picEt`, not `picSharp`. So no theorem among the 70 currently\
-  \ speaks about any curve.\n\nTHE PART THAT WAS AN UNTESTED JUDGEMENT, and is now\
-  \ measured. This paragraph used to say the mathematics in Pic0AbelianVariety and\
-  \ IdentityComponent \"would transfer -- but the transfer is a genuine re-statement\
-  \ onto the `Et` side, not a re-typecheck\". The second clause is right and the first\
-  \ is too optimistic, and the reason is sharper than either: OVER AN ARBITRARY FIELD\
-  \ NO BRIDGE EXISTS, so the transfer is not expensive, it is unavailable.\n\nProbed\
-  \ complete and axiom-clean ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx,\
-  \ against a control that correctly reports sorryAx), as an iff:\n\n  IsIso (PicScheme.picEtComparison\
-  \ C)  <-->  exists X representing picSharp C (with LocallyOfFiniteType, IsSeparated)\n\
-  \ngiven the unconditional `[HasPicSchemeEt C]`. Forward: obtain the etale gate's\
-  \ witness and transport by `rep.ofIso (asIso (picEtComparison C)).symm` -- the SAME\

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSubcanonical

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits
universe u

namespace GroundAudit

/-- The reviewer's claimed reduction: BOTH conjuncts of the seam from the single
picSharp-representability hypothesis. -/
theorem both_conjuncts_of_picSharp {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (h : ∃ (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))),
        Nonempty ((Scheme.PicScheme.picSharp C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
          LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom) :

        Nonempty ((Scheme.PicScheme.picEt C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
          LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom)
      ∧ (Scheme.HasRationalPoint C → IsIso (Scheme.PicScheme.picEtComparison C)) := by
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨rep⟩, hlft, hsep⟩ := h
  refine ⟨⟨X, ⟨Scheme.picSharp_representableBy_picEt_transport C rep⟩, hlft, hsep⟩,
    fun _ => Scheme.isIso_picEtComparison_of_picSharp_representability C rep⟩

#print axioms GroundAudit.both_conjuncts_of_picSharp

    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :

          LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom)
      ∧ (Scheme.HasRationalPoint C → IsIso (Scheme.PicScheme.picEtComparison C)) :=
  Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability C

#print axioms GroundAudit.control_no_hyp

end GroundAudit
EOF

## The topology parameter

Mathlib does not provide an étale Grothendieck topology on schemes (only the morphism
property `AlgebraicGeometry.Etale`), so `PicSharp.etSheaf` takes the topology
`J : GrothendieckTopology (Over (Spec k))` as a parameter, to be specialised to the
canonical étale topology once that is available.  Sheafifying is not cosmetic:
`Pic^♯_{C/k}` is in general not representable (Kleiman L5105–L5108; see the §5
note below, and do **not** restore the older "not even a Zariski sheaf" reason,
which no source supports for the *relative* functor).
